text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Today marks the start of a long and
arduous
journey in the Twinkle Series for
me and my
trainee. Her name is...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Nakayama Festa. Just sayin' now, but I'm
not one
for races with obvious outcomes.
I'm in it for the
thrill.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
So just remember—you ever chicken out
on me,
this little arrangement of ours is
over.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Got it? Good. Now let's get straight to
the fun
stuff.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so begin my days challenging the
Twinkle
Series with
<chrname>!
